_evidence: Family layout for the 0x160-byte track-segment ring at 0x8943a0. Positions are record-aligned pointers (points_into): lap start [0x891504] 0..4, lap end [0x866ecc] 4..26, pit start [0x891500] 0..30, pit end [0x866ef8] 1..32 (all orders against each other), the walk start [0x626990] 0..29, and a wrap distance [0x866ec4] of 1..4 records (never more than the lap end), exactly as ring_004317ae/ring_0043ec1a. The forward advance used by 0x43dd13/0x43e7bd/0x43e867/0x43ea29/0x43eb10/0x43f696 (+0x160; < lap end keep; < pit start subtract the wrap; < pit end keep; else pit end - 0x160) and its 0x86857a variant (+0x160 unless >= pit end) map record p <= 31 to a record in 0..31 (p+1 <= 31, p+1-D >= lap end - D >= 0, pit end - 1 <= 31), so every visited record is 0..31 for any number of steps; the backward walk of 0x43e768 (clamp at pit start, or wrap +D below lap start: <= lap start - 1 + D <= 7) stays in 0..max(start,7). 0x43d6b4 walks from the lap start with its own wrap ([0x866eb8] end 4..26 minus [0x866ebc] 1..4 records, so >= 0) for word [0x868558]+0x100 iterations (16-bit: 0..0x8ff, or negative = one pass; 0x7fxx would be a 32768-step walk and is not drawn). Register record pointers use rec[0x8943a0,0x160,0..29]. The step-by-step byte walks of 0x43e768/0x43e7bd/0x43e867 store the running al into +0x6b, so a revisited record always ends them (at most 33 steps). Record fields of records 0..31 vary: bytes +0x10/+0x12 (RMW)/+0x51 (bit 7 test, RMW)/+0x6b/+0x73 (RMW)/+0xa8 (RMW)/+0xb6 (index into the 0x40-stride table 0x626fb8, whose 256 dwords +0 vary: any byte stays inside .data), word +0x14 and word +0xa6 (0..0x6000: both sides of the 0x2000 band), and word +2 of records -1..32 (0x43ea29 reads [edi+0x162] and [edi-0x15e]). 0x43fc28 walks three do-while ranges [0x627b48]->[0x603ed0]->[0x627b5c]->[0x627b4c] ending on 'jne', so those are record pointers 0..24 (start >= end skips: both orders). Selector bytes 0x86857a and 0x627b65 are zero in half the picks. Loop count [0x62ac48] is 0..40 (0x43dd13 'loop' would run 2^32 times on a negative count, 0x43eb10 shifts it). Variant for 0x0043f696: n1 = max(0, b50 - ((((0x6000 - min(|[0x627b30]|,0x6000)) * [0x6247e8]) >> 14) * b50 >> 14)) with b50=[0x627b50] in 0..300, [0x6247e8] in 0..0x2aaa and |[0x627b30]| <= 0x10000 lies in 0..300 (|[0x627b30]| = 2^31 would make n1 ~2^25). Loop 1 runs n1 steps dividing (esi<<14)/n1 with esi < n1 (no #DE), loop 2 [0x627b58] (0..8) steps, then n2 = [0x62ac48] - n1 - [0x627b58] and loop 3 divides (esi<<14)/n2 for esi = 0..n2: n2 = 0 is the original's own #DE. Since n1 + [0x627b58] <= 308, the count is drawn from small negatives (n2 < 0: js exit, both before any count-sized loop) or 309..600 (n2 >= 1), so n2 is never 0 and both js outcomes occur; a count of INT_MIN would wrap n2 positive. Later loops run (b58>>1)+b50 >= 0 and the remaining count, so all loops are bounded. [0x627b54] in +-300 reaches both 0x7f/-0x80 clamps. Block 0x43f706 is dead: in loop 1 0 <= esi < n1 so (esi<<14)/n1 - 0x4000 is in [-0x4000,-1] and sar 8 gives [-64,-1], never 0.
